description: This file contains Kotlin source code implementing device authentication token storage for an Android app. It defines data classes, interfaces, and a class for managing device tokens and associated metadata using secure preferences.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a device authentication token, role, scopes, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Serializable data class for persisting metadata related to device authentication, including scopes and timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device authentication tokens.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that manages tokens using SecurePrefs with JSON serialization.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a device authentication entry from preferences based on device ID and role.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Stores a device token along with its scopes and timestamp into preferences.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes device token and metadata entries for a given device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Generates the key used to store the token in preferences.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Generates the key used to store the token metadata in preferences.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Normalizes device IDs by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Normalizes roles by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Normalizes a list of scopes by trimming, filtering out empty entries, removing duplicates, and sorting.
